Question: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold in delivered orders? Use English category names.
text:
```sql
SELECT 
    pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct
    ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
This query counts how many order‑item rows belong to each product category for orders marked as delivered, then returns the five categories with the highest counts, using the English category names.
